notes: Backgrounds can now be adjusted for Brightness and Contrast. Each scene's Background section gets a new 'Brightness & Contrast' panel with two sliders (0–200%, 100% = unchanged) plus a Reset button — they sit alongside the existing Blur control and apply to any background type (image, video, color, gradient). The adjustment shows live in the scene preview and is baked into the final render. Also rolls in the earlier fixes: Align H/V keep the other axis (v1.5.2) and updates no longer open a duplicate browser tab (v1.5.1).
